description: This file defines the ShellExecutor utility in Swift, providing methods to run shell commands asynchronously with detailed result handling, including timeout capabilities and process execution management.

classes.name: ShellExecutor
classes.description: A utility class encapsulating methods to execute shell commands asynchronously with detailed output, error handling, and timeout support.

methods.name: runDetailed
methods.description: Executes a shell command with optional current working directory, environment variables, and timeout, returning a detailed ShellResult.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes a shell command with optional current working directory, environment variables, and timeout, returning a simplified Response object.

methods.name: runDetailed
methods.description: Executes a command asynchronously, providing detailed output including stdout, stderr, exit code, timeout status, and errors.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Wraps runDetailed to provide a simplified response with success status, message, and payload.
